2609.35544.title: Less Sycophancy, Stronger Refusal? Lessons for AI Safety from Mechanistic Interpretability
2609.35544.paper_summary: Reliable refusal of harmful requests is essential to the safe deployment of language models. Because excessive eagerness to please users may undermine existing refusal capabilities, reducing sycophancy offers a potential route to stronger refusal beyond the harmful scenarios covered by safety training. We investigate this possibility using compensatory feature injection (CFI), a training technique designed to limit the acquisition of a target concept by supplying its associated activation during learning. Across three Qwen3.5 base models, we use sparse autoencoders (SAEs) to identify the top-ranked sycophancy feature from paired sycophantic and independent responses, then validate its behavioral influence through inference steering. We subsequently inject the selected feature during supervised fine-tuning on sycophantic targets. Positive injection reduces learned sycophancy after removal (by 62.0% relative to ordinary fine-tuning in 35B-A3B), whereas modest negative injection increases it. Unexpectedly, these reductions in sycophancy do not consistently improve direct refusal of harmful requests, motivating a narrower evaluation of the same harmful intents under user pressure. In this setting, ordinary fine-tuning on sycophantic responses substantially weakens refusal, while selected checkpoints trained with positive injection recover part of the loss, including approximately 95% in 35B-A3B. These findings show that persistent sycophancy reduction does not guarantee stronger direct refusal, while identifying recovery under user pressure as a distinct, conditional benefit of training intervention.
2609.35544.paper_summary_zh: 可靠地拒絕有害請求對於安全部署語言模型至關重要。因為過度渴望取悅用戶可能會削弱現有的拒絕能力，減少諂媚行為提供了一條潛在的途徑，以在安全訓練所涵蓋的有害場景之外實現更強的拒絕。我們使用補償特徵注入（CFI）來調查這一可能性，這是一種訓練技術，旨在通過在學習過程中提供其相關激活來限制目標概念的獲取。在三個Qwen3.5基礎模型中，我們使用稀疏自編碼器（SAEs）來識別從配對的諂媚和獨立回應中排名最高的諂媚特徵，然後通過推理引導驗證其行為影響。隨後，我們在對諂媚目標的監督微調過程中注入所選特徵。正向注入在移除後減少了學習到的諂媚行為（相對於35B-A3B中的普通微調減少62.0%），而適度的負向注入則增加了諂媚行為。出乎意料的是，這些諂媚行為的減少並不一致地改善對有害請求的直接拒絕，促使我們在用戶壓力下對相同有害意圖進行更狹窄的評估。在這種情況下，對諂媚回應的普通微調顯著削弱了拒絕，而使用正向注入訓練的選定檢查點則恢復了部分損失，包括在35B-A3B中約95%。這些發現表明，持續減少諂媚行為並不保證更強的直接拒絕，同時在用戶壓力下識別恢復作為訓練干預的一個獨特的、有條件的好處。
